sections.Profile:
Dragon , released by Interflip S.A. of Madrid in December 1977, is a four-player electro-mechanical game with a dragon theme, built for export; five standing dragon targets fall flat when hit and set off an electronic growl. It is unrelated to Gottlieb's 1978 Dragon , and a one-player version was sold in Spain as Recreativos Franco's Dragoon .

- Manufacturer: Interflip S. A.
- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Original Theme, 1970s, Dragons, Adventure, Fantasy
